records.jp: リフナビがいない？
そうなんだよ。たぶん、あの時だと思うんだけど――
records.en_original: That's right. Ever since that time...
records.en: That's right. Ever since that time...

records.jp: みんな！　気を付けて！<CR>何か――何か起きてる！！
records.en_original: Everybody, be careful! Something... Something's happening!
records.en: Everybody, be careful! Something... Something's happening!

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続にｓ失敗しししっｓｍあｍした
あれ以降、フリスペで話しかけても返事がなくて……

records.en: Ever since then, I haven't been able to get a response, even on FreeSpace...

records.jp: 言われてみれば、しばらく見ていない……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it... It has been quite a while since I've seen anything from it...
records.en: Now that you mention it... It has been quite a while since I've seen anything from it...

records.jp: 改めて確認するけど、<CR>リフナビってユズさんが作ったものじゃないんだよね？
records.en_original: I know I asked this already, but you're not the one who created ReSource, right?
records.en: Let me make sure again: ReSource wasn't something you created, Yuzu-san, right?

records.jp: うん。私は何も知らない……
records.en_original: No. I haven't the slightest idea who did.
records.en: No. I haven't the slightest idea who did.

records.jp: ……そもそも、リフナビの言っていることは<CR>前から不可解だった
records.en_original: ReSource never made much sense in the first place.
records.en: ReSource never made much sense in the first place.

records.jp: 普通のリフレクターが知りえない情報を持ってるし、<CR>目的もよく分からない……
records.en_original: It had information a normal Reflector wouldn't know... What could it have wanted?
records.en: It had information a normal Reflector wouldn't know... What could it have wanted?

records.jp: もしかしたら、あのアカウントも<CR>世界システムの差し金かも……
records.en_original: Could it be a part of the World System too...?
records.en: Could it be a part of the World System too...?

records.jp: なら、なんで私たちに<CR>色々教えてくれたんだろう……？
records.en_original: But then why would it help us...?
records.en: But then why would it help us...?

records.jp: うーん……
●カット
リフナビさん！
いる？
やっぱり返事がない……
私もやってみる
リフナビ、あなたは敵なの？　味方なの？
records.en_original: ReSource, are you an ally? Or our enemy?
records.en: ReSource, are you an ally? Or our enemy?

records.jp: 世界システムとつながってるの？
records.en_original: Are you connected to the World System?
records.en: Are you connected to the World System?

records.jp: 黙ってないで出てこい
リフナビを再起動中です
な、なんか始まった！？
リフナビの再起動を完了しました

何それ……？
リフナビさん？
「クマのぬいぐるみ」を作成してください
クマのぬいぐるみって何？
records.en_original: What's this about a teddy bear?
records.en: What's this about a teddy bear?

records.jp: 「クマのぬいぐるみ」を作成してください
「クマのぬいぐるみ」を作成してください

作成手順を送信します

records.en: Wasn't ReSource, I dunno, a bit more high-energy?

records.jp: どうなってるの……？
愛央！　ユズ！　何かあったの！？
ずっといなかったリフナビに話しかけたら、<CR>突然変なことを言い始めて……

records.en: ReSource is back, but it's acting strange...

records.jp: ちょっとまって
そっちに行く！　教室にいる？
records.en_original: I'm on my way! Are you in the classroom?
records.en: I'm on my way! Are you in the classroom?

二人とも！
どうしたの、そんなに慌てて……？
こ、このクマ！
私……このクマ、知ってる
